## What is now concrete

POINT purpose, evaluator limits, provisional recovery targets, constant occurrence
weights, matching removal/rejoin, residual relearning and the replacement-model
roles are filled from approval. They need no repeat vote. The amendment draft
incorporates S1 into B01–B12 and gives exact candidate profile versions and source
dependencies. Those candidate texts are not installed in PTC, MAP or VAL.

Read-only recovery also verified the preserved C31 executable and four small
configuration/provenance files against recorded hashes. That establishes an
artifact-backed **refactor-era** reference, not the required f70701ad executable.
The latter still lacks an exact executable/environment/input binding. No binary
was run and no scientific array, map, noise value or fit was opened.

The recovered historical S/N rule is also more specific than its name suggests:
it thresholds projected signal divided by a per-array scalar `MEDRMS`, alongside
separate flux/adaptive branches joined by OR. The f70701ad scalar is a median
of spatial RMS values from noise-realization maps. It is not a per-pixel inverse
variance or a probability. Moving to a pixel-domain ordinary-MAP S/N model is
an explicit adapter; deleting the historical flux branch changes the comparison.

## Remaining owner choices

These are recommendations under existing Q01–Q06, **not approved numbers**.
The acceptance of the POINT brief did not choose them.

| Decision | Recommendation and reason | Exact limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Q01/Q05: S/N evidence | Keep numerical S/N admission unavailable until one exact compatible current-generation scale/companion is supplied and its meaning approved. Retain the recovered scalar-score form as the reference to bind. | Do not choose a threshold from the legacy value 100 or invent a scale from gamma, Q, spatial scatter, or an unaccepted NOI method. No new noise experiment is proposed. |
| Q03: grouping and rank | Carry forward the proposed array-wide groups, with configured rank **5 per required array/segment**, as the first numerical-plan proposal. This fixes a modest declared reference; no rank search. | Array-wide rank 5 is not equivalent to network rank 5. The latter is recovered C31 configuration only. Exact fit/use masks, segment membership, metric, reconstruction and numerical rank tolerance remain required plan fields; this is not approval of a complete PTC plan. |
| Q04: MAP support | Propose **coverage_cut = 0.1**, admitted only as this method's single numerical policy value, on each array's complete fixed grid population. Apply frozen MAP's two separate support predicates exactly. | This deliberately proposes a familiar reference value; prior use does not approve it or establish adequate support. Other values, including nonfinite values, fail this proposed policy. No general numeric range is created. |
| Q06: endpoint | Propose **L = 6 including bootstrap**, with the final required completed bundle as endpoint, all passes retained, and no convergence-based early stop. This gives one bootstrap and five feedback transitions. | A bounded reference extent, not an optimal count or a convergence claim. All failure rules remain; stability/performance claims and numerical execution/resource plans remain unavailable. No failed run may select an earlier map. |

There is no need to solve every missing quantity now. The useful next action is
review of these three numerical-plan proposals and the explicit S/N hold, while
completing the source-adoption work already authorized in substance. The exact
historical-control artifact and S/N scale are missing evidence/authority, not
questions that another weighting sweep can answer.

## What completion means here

The record identifies every binding class and its state, including unavailable
fields. It is not a runnable recipe. A complete source-adoption set still needs
owner-reviewed PTC/MAP counterparts, matching VAL/source-binding rows and exact
release manifests; this draft does not assert those future hashes or activate
its candidate keys. A numerical request additionally needs exact inputs, all
PTC settings, valid S/N evidence, the evaluation protocol and resource limits.

Do not replace the mandatory historical control with C31 by inference. A request
to use a same-build compatibility control would be a separate scoped decision
with weaker claims. No new observation or reduction is requested in this packet.
129081 remains reserved and unopened for scientific values. Independent-pointing
replication still precedes a numerical policy recommendation. No implementation,
replay, Unity use, qualification, production or author dispatch occurred.

The [verification](VERIFICATION.md) and [manifest](REVIEW_MANIFEST.json) bind this
delivery; all prior briefs, results, reductions and protected archives remain.
